# Conflict Rule 4 - Keep consent, and player status, in mind during shuttle boarding:
\n
- Boarding other players shuttles is allowed, though we strongly recommend announcing or negotiating with individuals first.
- Shuttles are considered a private space, and while privacy markers exist within the play space, players are not required to mark their own ship as if they're adrift.
- Boarding shuttles without warning, puts the weight of consequences on the player boarding.
- Known hostile forces that are declared and confirmed to be hostile may be considered "belligerent"
- Belligerent shuttles may be boarded non-conventionally or have their systems disabled in attempt to secure bounties/serve justice.
